_comment: Rule set the kit gate's fixture site is scanned with (laid over the repo's config/content-policy-config.json with --config). Kept apart from any live site's rule sets so the gate's self-test does not move when those are tuned.

kit-fixture.description: Gate fixture: one negation-aware reject rule and one required notice.

rules.label: backfeeding a home through an outlet
rules.why: Backfeeding a home through an outlet energises the utility line and can kill a line worker.
rules.fix: Remove the instruction; say a transfer switch or interlock installed by a licensed electrician is required.

required_notices.label: the licensed-electrician notice
required_notices.message: A page that mentions a transfer switch must say that installing one takes a licensed electrician.
required_notices.suggested_text: A transfer switch must be installed by a licensed electrician.
